notes: Frontend redesign car (owner-approved, frontend freeze lifted): the local console is rebuilt as a sidebar application shell and the product site gains an onboarding path, trust section and architecture section - palette (#fcfcfa / #2892ff tech blue), droplet motif and honest-claims discipline unchanged. (1) Console app-shell (web/static): slim topbar (brand, uptime/info chips, clock, language switch, update banner) + fixed 236px sidebar with six views - Overview (five service status cards replacing the old decorative radar, usage & cost card, memory bars, channel table, advisory), Chat, Skills, Evolution, Stream, Settings (grouped form: Console / Usage / Model / Access). All views live in one document and toggle via CSS, so every element id contract, every poller, the chat SSE stream and the token store behave exactly as before; a new ?view= deep link (default overview) joins the preserved ?lang / ?skipboot / ?alert=urgent contracts. Retired: the center radar and reactor SVGs together with their JS blocks (id inventory 90 -> 85, audited: every id referenced by app.js exists in the DOM). Breakpoints 1000/760 px; the sidebar collapses to a horizontal scroll rail on small screens; verified no horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390. (2) Site advance (site/): the hero gains a fine grid backdrop and a Get Started primary CTA (two disabled placeholder buttons removed); new section 01 Get Started carries the real three-step quickstart (git clone, bash deploy/install.sh, aidog setup) in copyable command blocks; new section 05 Security & Trust (loopback by default, credentials reported by name and length only, token-gated writes, telemetry off, en/zh interface, free forever); new section 06 Architecture (replaceable kernel / body layer / business adapters as three bands) with the honest note that the self-developed core is under active development. The static console preview embedded in the site now mirrors the new shell instead of the retired radar layout; site nav is now seven anchors with burger support. (3) Research: docs/research/frontend_layout_reference.md records the layout patterns this car applied - model-knowledge based and explicitly marked as not fetched, because the build machine has no outbound network. (4) Locale: overlay packs 210 -> 225 keys (en/zh parity), site packs 89 -> 120 keys (en/zh parity); competitive-doc reference R14 re-synced. Verified gates: mycore 511/511, web smoke 68/68, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup wizard 80/80, srclint 0 (packs en=225 zh=225), doctor 9 active + 20 SKIP 0F/0W on a clean tree, publish READY(0) (tracked 119), run_service --check rc=0, boot status 6 green.
